blocks.en: Suppose that machine A and machine B are both connected to the Internet. Machine A wants to send a message to machine B, but the two machines are not directly connected to each other. How does machine A know where to send the message, so that the message will eventually reach machine B? What path will the message take through the network to reach its destination of machine B? In this unit, we’ll be studying routing to answer these questions.
blocks.zh_html: 假设机器 A 和机器 B 都连接到了互联网(Internet)。机器 A 想向机器 B 发送一条消息，但两台机器并没有直接相连。机器 A 怎么知道应该把消息发往哪里，才能让消息最终到达机器 B？这条消息会沿着网络中的哪条路径(path)到达目的地(destination)机器 B？本单元会学习路由(routing)，用来回答这些问题。

blocks.en: First, we’ll devise a model of the Internet so that we can pose routing as a well-defined problem. We’ll also see what answers to the routing problem look like, and what makes an answer valid and good.
blocks.zh_html: 首先，我们会构造一个互联网(Internet)模型(model)，使路由(routing)可以被表述为一个定义清楚的问题。我们还会看到路由问题的答案长什么样，以及什么样的答案才算有效(valid)且好。

blocks.en: Next, we’ll look at several different types of routing protocols that can be implemented to help generate answers to the routing problem. We’ll also see how addressing protocols can be used to make our routing protocols scalable to the entire Internet.
blocks.zh_html: 接下来，我们会考察几类可以实现的路由协议(routing protocols)，它们能帮助生成路由问题的答案。我们还会看到如何利用寻址协议(addressing protocols)，让路由协议能够扩展(scalable)到整个互联网。

blocks.en: Finally, we’ll take a brief look at the real-life hardware we use to implement these routing protocols.
blocks.zh_html: 最后，我们会简要了解现实中用于实现这些路由协议(routing protocols)的硬件(hardware)。
域间路由(inter-domain routing)与域内路由(intra-domain routing)

blocks.en: One possible strategy for routing is to build a model of the Internet that includes every single machine in the world, and design a single giant routing protocol that will allow us to send packets anywhere in the world. However, this is infeasible in practice because of the scale of the Internet.
blocks.zh_html: 一种可能的路由(routing)策略是：建立一个包含世界上每一台机器的互联网模型，然后设计一个巨大的统一路由协议(routing protocol)，让我们可以把分组(packets)发送到世界任意地方。不过，由于互联网(Internet)规模太大，这在实践中不可行。

blocks.en: Instead, we’ll take advantage of the fact that the Internet is a network of networks. In other words, the Internet consists of many local networks. Each local network implements its own routing protocol that specifies how to send packets within just that local network. Then, we can connect up all those local networks and implement a routing protocol across all the local networks, specifying how to send packets between different local networks.
blocks.zh_html: 相反，我们会利用这样一个事实：互联网(Internet)是网络的网络(network of networks)。换句话说，互联网由许多本地网络(local networks)组成。每个本地网络实现自己的路由协议(routing protocol)，规定如何只在这个本地网络内部发送分组(packets)。随后，我们把这些本地网络连接起来，并在所有本地网络之间实现一种路由协议，用来规定不同本地网络之间如何发送分组。

blocks.en: Local networks are not identical. For example, they might differ in size: Some networks might have more machines than others. Or, the machines might be spread out over a wider physical area (e.g. the entire UC Berkeley campus), or a smaller area (e.g. your home). Networks can also differ in the bandwidth they need to support, the allowable failure rate, the number of support staff available, the age of the infrastructure, the amount of money available to build and support it, and so on.
blocks.zh_html: 本地网络(local networks)并不完全相同。例如，它们的规模可能不同：有些网络包含的机器比其他网络更多。机器也可能分布在更大的物理区域内，例如整个 UC Berkeley 校园；也可能只分布在较小区域内，例如你的家。不同网络还可能在需要支持的带宽(bandwidth)、可接受的故障率(failure rate)、可用运维人员数量、基础设施(infrastructure)年限、建设和维护预算等方面有所不同。

blocks.en: Because each network has its own structure and requirements, different local networks might choose to use different routing protocols. A strategy for routing packets might be effective on one network, but not another one.
blocks.zh_html: 由于每个网络都有自己的结构(structure)和需求(requirements)，不同本地网络(local networks)可能会选择不同的路由协议(routing protocols)。一种分组路由策略在某个网络中可能很有效，但在另一个网络中未必适用。

blocks.en: With the network of networks model, we can let individual local networks choose a routing strategy for packets within their network. Each operator can choose the protocol that works best for them. The protocols for routing packets within a local network are called intra-domain routing protocols, or interior gateway protocols (IGPs). Real-world examples include OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) and IS-IS (Intermediate System to Intermediate System).
blocks.zh_html: 在网络的网络(network of networks)模型下，我们可以让每个本地网络(local network)自行选择其内部的分组路由策略。每个运营方(operator)都可以选择最适合自己的协议(protocol)。用于在本地网络内部为分组选择路径的协议称为域内路由协议(intra-domain routing protocols)，也称内部网关协议(Interior Gateway Protocols, IGPs)。现实中的例子包括 OSPF(Open Shortest Path First) 和 IS-IS(Intermediate System to Intermediate System)。

blocks.en: By contrast, protocols for routing packets across different networks are called inter-domain routing protocols, or exterior gateway protocols (EGPs). In order to support sending packets across different local networks, every network needs to agree to use the same protocol for routing packets between each other. If different networks used different inter-domain protocols, there’s no guarantee that that the entire Internet could be connected in a consistent way. What if one operator only implemented Protocol X, and another operator only implemented Protocol Y? It’s not clear how these two local networks would be able to exchange messages.
blocks.zh_html: 相比之下，用于在不同网络之间路由分组的协议称为域间路由协议(inter-domain routing protocols)，也称外部网关协议(Exterior Gateway Protocols, EGPs)。为了支持跨不同本地网络(local networks)发送分组，每个网络都需要同意使用同一种网络间路由协议。如果不同网络使用不同的域间协议(inter-domain protocols)，就无法保证整个互联网(Internet)能以一致的方式连通。假如一个运营方(operator)只实现协议 X，而另一个运营方只实现协议 Y，这两个本地网络该如何交换消息并不清楚。

blocks.en: Because every network must agree to use the same inter-domain protocol, there is only one protocol implemented at scale on the Internet, namely BGP (Border Gateway Protocol).
blocks.zh_html: 因为每个网络都必须同意使用同一种域间协议(inter-domain protocol)，所以互联网上真正大规模部署的此类协议只有一个，也就是 BGP(Border Gateway Protocol，边界网关协议)。

blocks.en: This model of interior and exterior gateway protocols is convenient for intuition, but in practice, there is not always a clear distinction between them. For example, BGP is sometimes also used inside a local network, in addition to between different networks.
blocks.zh_html: 内部网关协议(interior gateway protocols)和外部网关协议(exterior gateway protocols)这个模型有助于建立直觉，但在实践中，两者并不总是界限分明。例如，BGP 有时不仅用于不同网络之间，也会在某个本地网络(local network)内部使用。

blocks.en: Regardless of whether a protocol is deployed internally within a network, or externally between all networks, we can additionally classify the routing protocol by looking at what the underlying algorithm is doing. In particular, we’ll study distance-vector protocols, link-state protocols, and path-vector protocols (more about each type later).
blocks.zh_html: 无论某个协议(protocol)是部署在网络内部，还是部署在所有网络之间，我们还可以根据底层算法(algorithm)的工作方式来分类路由协议(routing protocol)。具体来说，我们会学习距离向量协议(distance-vector protocols)、链路状态协议(link-state protocols)和路径向量协议(path-vector protocols)，后面会分别详细讨论。
